retrievalProfile.description: A moody, low-key portrait of a male subject leaning against a weathered door in a brick-walled industrial space, featuring centered ultra-condensed typography.
excludeWhen: vibrant or neon color palettes are requested
minimalist flat design is the goal

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man in rugged attire leaning against a vertical wooden doorframe within a dark, textured brick interior. The lighting is directional, highlighting the subject's face and hands while casting deep shadows. A large, thin, condensed sans-serif title is superimposed across the center, partially obscured by the subject's torso to create depth.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning against vertical architectural elements to create a diagonal posture
Typography layered between the subject and the background for a 3D effect
Muted, desaturated color palette harmonizing with the industrial setting
High contrast between the warm skin tones and the cool, dark background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned slightly off-center to the left, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the central horizontal line of the typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down the body to the hands, then across the horizontal text spanning the width of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark negative space on the right side composed of shadowed brickwork.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark charcoal and umber (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm beige and tan (skin tones and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout with high value contrast between highlights and deep shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and denim blues

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for maximum impact; no secondary type.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme verticality and clean sans-serif structure.
Provides the necessary condensed uppercase feel with a modern edge.
Offers a similar industrial, squared-off condensed look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a moody, low-key portrait of a man in a dark jacket and jeans leaning against a weathered wooden door in a dark brick room. Use directional lighting to create strong highlights on his face and hands. Apply a desaturated, earthy color grade with visible film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of centered, uppercase text in an ultra-condensed sans-serif font across the middle of the image. Mask the text so it appears to sit behind the subject's torso but in front of the background.

verificationChecks: Is the text ultra-condensed and uppercase?
Is the lighting directional and low-key?
Is the color palette desaturated and earthy?
Does the text appear layered behind the subject?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is centered and spans most of the frame width.
Check that the subject's face is the brightest part of the image.
Verify the background bricks have a realistic, aged texture.
Confirm the typography is behind the subject's arms/body.
recipe.reuseFormula: Rustic Industrial Portrait + Ultra-Condensed Sans-Serif + Layered Depth Composition
